selected.title: US prosecutors seize Tether-linked payment firm's bank accounts - FT
selected.summary: US federal prosecutors have seized bank accounts belonging Capstone, a payments business working on behalf of stablecoin issuer Tether and its sister exchange Bitfinex, according to the Financial Times.
selected.why: Federal law enforcement action seizing bank accounts connected to Tether payment processing.

reason: Seizing Tether payment processors raises arguable questions about whether enforcement targets the right layer of crypto infrastructure
angle: Prosecuting payment intermediaries may be counterproductive if the goal is regulating stablecoins themselves rather than pushing activity further underground
